findings.detail: The Prisma composite unique for the future tenant-custom case is materialised as `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "roles_key_institutionId_key"` rather than a named `ADD CONSTRAINT ... UNIQUE`. Functionally equivalent and Prisma-compatible (`prisma generate` and the full build are green, and Prisma treats a matching unique index as satisfying `@@unique([key, institutionId])`), but it diverges from the usual Prisma-emitted constraint shape and from B-1's `ADD CONSTRAINT` convention. Non-blocking; no action required for Phase 0.

summary: CAMPASS Phase 0 Identity & RBAC (B-2) faithfully realizes the authoritative design across all four FEATs, and the full suite is green (17 files / 142 tests incl. the live Supabase cross-tenant escape suite, catalogue-sync meta-test, and per-group auth-regression tests; shared + api builds clean). Every checklist item verified against the actual code: (1) institution_memberships and membership_roles both carry institutionId + composite FKs ((userId,institutionId)->users RESTRICT, (departmentScope,institutionId)->departments RESTRICT MATCH SIMPLE nullable, (membershipId,institutionId)->institution_memberships RESTRICT) + RLS ENABLE+FORCE + tenant_isolation_select/modify fail-closed policies + RLS_TABLES coverage, all in the single identity_rbac_b2 migration. (2) Role is NOT RLS; all five templates have institutionId=NULL guarded by the roles_key_template_unique partial index. (3) Backfill excludes SUPER_ADMIN and PLATFORM-institution users and binds exactly one template role per membership, with the null-tenant guard and the exactly-one (count<>1) DO $$ guard present verbatim. (4) The JWT is the canonical dual-shape payload { userId, membershipId, institutionId, roles, permissions, permissionsVersion, role, jti } keeping the legacy role claim. (5) authenticate runs exactly once via a single top-level hook per flipped file; requirePermission is a pure can-check that never re-authenticates and 401s defensively if request.auth is unset. (6) The SUPER_ADMIN branch sets request.tenant undefined and never feeds the PLATFORM institutionId to app.current_institution_id (carried for logging only). (7) Guard/student/hod/admin route flips match the §7 table exactly (every admin route carries its per-route key); platform.ts stays requireSuperAdmin and notifications.ts stays bare authenticate (both unmodified). (8) requireModuleActive carries the exact PHASE-0 STUB marker and is pinned permit-all. (9) The frozen B-1 migration is byte-for-byte untouched; the GRANT block never grants BYPASSRLS to campass_app; User.role/User.institutionId and the legacy role claim are all kept; §9 deferred items (module entitlement, self-service role editing, MFA wiring, canOnResource, at-action DB re-check/step-up) are correctly out of scope. Only a single NIT (a unique index vs named constraint for the deferred tenant-custom case) — not blocking.
